basic_details.job_title: CCS HAU Young Professional Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Two Young Professional-II (YP-II) posts on contractual basis are open in the Oilseeds Section, Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding, CCS Haryana Agril. University (CCS HAU), Hisar, under the scheme 5396-C(b) PB-183-ICAR, with emoluments of ₹42000/- p.m. fixed and a term up to 31.03.2027 that is likely to be extended. The essential qualification is M.Sc. in Genetics and Plant Breeding or a graduate degree in relevant Agricultural Sciences. Applications on the prescribed proforma (Annexure A) must be received in the department office by 20.11.2026 (F.N.), and the interview will be held on 2

how_to_apply: Prepare the application on the prescribed proforma (Annexure A).
Make sure the application is complete in all respects.
Send or deliver it to the office of the Professor & Head, Dept of Genetics and Plant Breeding, CCS Haryana Agril. University, Hisar – 125004.
The application must reach that office latest by 20.11.2026 (F.N.); no application received after that will be entertained for any reason.
The notice does not mention whether the application should be sent by post or by hand.
Original certificates, to be produced/shown at the interview
Certified true copies or original certificates, to be submitted to the University
NOC from the Dean PGS (Ph.D. students only), at the interview
Medical certificate of fitness from the CMO of the University, at the time of joining
Agreement on a non-judicial stamped paper of Rs. 15/-, before joining the post
important_instructions: The selected candidate should report for duty within 15 days of issue of the appointment order; otherwise the appointment will be treated as cancelled and may be offered to any other selected candidate. The YP-II will be under the administrative control of the project PI and will be entitled to leave as per university guidelines/norms. The engagement is full time; the YP-II will not be allowed to do any other work or to accept or hold another appointment, with or without remuneration, elsewhere. The university may modify, add, delete and/or amend/change the rules with the approval of the Vice-Chancellor, CCS HAU Hisar. The notice has been sent to the Additional Director Students Counseling & Placement, CCS HAU, to inform unemployed registered candidates, and to the Divisional Employment Exchange, Mini Secretariat, Hisar.

content_sections.heading: About CCS HAU
content_sections.text: CCS Haryana Agril. University (CCS HAU) is an agricultural university at Hisar, Haryana. The notice comes from its Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding, and both posts serve the scheme 5396-C(b) PB-183-ICAR in the department's Oilseeds Section. The Principal Investigator of the scheme is Dr. Ram Avtar, and the discipline of the posts is listed as Genetics and Plant Breeding & Agronomy.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age is counted on the last date of submission of application, 20.11.2026. Ph.D. students may apply but must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Dean PGS at the time of interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.as_printed_in_the_notice: M.Sc. in Genetics and Plant Breeding or graduate degree holder in relevant Agricultural Sciences
Candidate having working experience on mustard will be given preference
Minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years on the last date of submission of application

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Young Professional-II (YP-II) receives emoluments of ₹42000/- p.m. fixed. TA/DA will be payable equivalent to the entitlement of Grade-IV employees as mentioned in the CCS HAU TA Rules of the University; however, no TA/DA is payable for appearing in the interview. The appointment is only for the specified time period; the term in one time will be up to 31-3-2027. The maximum duration of engagement of YP-II is three years (1+1+1+1+1)/duration of the post, whichever is earlier. If work and conduct are not found satisfactory, the services can be terminated any time after giving due opportunity. Services are also liable to be terminated at any point of time, without assigning any reason, because of non-release of funds by the funding agency of the project/scheme. A selected candidate who wants to leave can do so after giving one month notice or one-month emoluments in lieu thereof to the University. The YP-II will not be a regular employee and will not be entitled to any CPF/GPF or other benefits admissible to regular employees. On completion of the project/term, the YP-II will stand relieved, and the university/department will not be responsible for adjustment in the university.

Send or deliver it to the office of the Professor & Head, Dept of Genetics and Plant Breeding, CCS Haryana Agril. University, Hisar – 125004. The application must reach that office latest by 20.11.2026 (F.N.); no application received after that will be entertained for any reason. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The interview for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) posts will be held on 21 November 2026 at 2.30 PM in the office of the Director of Research, CCS HAU, Hisar. No separate letter for the interview will be issued, and no TA/DA will be paid for attending it. Candidates must bring their original certificates and also certified true copies or original certificates to be submitted to the University. Working experience on mustard will be given preference.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CCS HAU Young Professional-II recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts of Young Professional-II (YP-II) in Genetics and Plant Breeding.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CCS HAU YP-II?
faq.answer: The complete application must be received in the department office latest by 20.11.2026 (F.N.); later applications will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the CCS HAU YP-II post?
faq.answer: M.Sc. in Genetics and Plant Breeding or a graduate degree in relevant Agricultural Sciences; working experience on mustard will be given preference.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CCS HAU Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: Minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years on the last date of submission of application, with relaxation as per university rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of CCS HAU YP-II?
faq.answer: The emoluments are ₹42000/- p.m. fixed.

faq.question: Q6. How to apply for CCS HAU YP-II recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply on the prescribed proforma (Annexure A) to the office of the Professor & Head, Dept of Genetics and Plant Breeding, CCS Haryana Agril. University, Hisar – 125004, so that it is received by 20.11.2026 (F.N.).

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the CCS HAU YP-II interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 21.11.2026 at 2.30 PM in the office of the Director of Research, CCS HAU, Hisar; no separate interview letter will be issued.

faq.question: Q8. Is the CCS HAU YP-II post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contractual post up to 31.03.2027, likely to be extended, and the YP-II will not be a regular employee or get CPF/GPF benefits.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the CCS HAU YP-II interview?
faq.answer: No, no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can Ph.D. students apply for CCS HAU YP-II?
faq.answer: Yes, but Ph.D. students have to produce an NOC from the Dean PGS at the time of interview.
